title: MERIT x Erdem Signature Lip Gift Set
descriptionHtml:
✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Fragrance Free✓ Vegan
What it is: A limited-edition set designed in collaboration with ERDEM, featuring three Signature Lip lipsticks in three different finishes.

Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, retinyl palmitate, oxybenzone, coal tar, hydroquinone, sulfates SLS & SLES, triclocarban, triclosan, and contains less than one percent synthetic fragrance. These products are also vegan, gluten-free, and cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: Created in collaboration with ERDEM for the holiday season, this limited-edition gift set features three Signature Lip shades in three different finishes—housed in a custom gift box designed with ERDEM’s signature florals. It include
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Apply directly to lips.
-Layer for more intensity.
-Reapply throughout the day as needed.
Ingredients+
Signature Lip Satin:
Dimethicone, Ethylhexyl Palmitate, Synthetic Wax, Calcium Carbonate, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Hydrogenated Olive Oil, Kaolin, Polyglyceryl-3 Diisostearate, Dimethicone/Vinyl Dimethicone Crosspolymer, Euphorbia Cerifera (Candelilla) Wax (Euphorbia Cerifera Cera/Cire de candelilla), Olea Europaea (Olive) Fruit Oil, Stearalkonium Hectorite, Olea Europaea (Olive) Oil Unsaponifiables, Dimethyl Isosorbide, Propylene Carbonate, Isopropyl Titanium Triisostearate, Sesamum Indicum (Sesame) Seed Extract, Propylene Glycol, Tocopherol; May Contain/Peut Contenir (+/-): CI 77891 (Titanium Dioxide), CI 77491 / CI 77492 /CI 77499 (Iron Oxides), CI 45410 (Red 27 Lake), CI 15850 (Red 7 Lake), CI 42090 (Blue 1 Lake), CI 19140 (Yellow 5 Lake), CI 17200 (Red 33 Lake), CI 73360 (Red 30 Lake). 26023

Signature Lip Blush:
Dimethicone, Ethylhexyl Palmitate, Synthetic Wax, Calcium Carbonate,
Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Hydrogenated Olive Oil, Kaolin, Polyglyceryl-3
Diisostearate, Dimethicone/Vinyl Dimethicone Crosspolymer, Euphorbia Cerifera (Candelilla) Wax (Euphorbia Cerifera Cera/Cire de candelilla), Olea Europaea (Olive) Fruit Oil, Stearalkonium Hectorite, Olea Europaea (Olive) Oil Unsaponifiables, Dimethyl Isosorbide, Propylene Carbonate, Isopropyl Titanium Triisostearate, Sesamum Indicum (Sesame) Seed Extract, Propylene Glycol, Tocopherol; May Contain/Peut Contenir (+/-): CI 77891
(Titanium Dioxide), CI 77491 / CI 77492 /CI 77499 (Iron Oxides), CI 45410 (Red 27 Lake), CI 15850 (Red 7 Lake), CI 42090 (Blue 1 Lake), CI 19140 (Yellow 5 Lake), CI 17200 (Red 33 Lake), CI 73360 (Red 30 Lake).

Signature Lip Matte:
Dimethicone, Ethylhexyl Palmitate, Synthetic Wax, Calcium Carbonate, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Hydrogenated Olive Oil, Kaolin, Polyglyceryl-3 Diisostearate, Silica, Euphorbia Cerifera (Candelilla) Wax (Euphorbia Cerifera Cera/Cire de candelilla), Olea Europaea (Olive) Fruit Oil, Dimethicone/Vinyl Dimethicone Crosspolymer, Stearalkonium Hectorite, Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, Olea Europaea (Olive) Oil Unsaponifiables, Dimethyl Isosorbide, Sodium Hyaluronate, Propylene Carbonate, Isopropyl Titanium Triisostearate, Hydrogenated Castor Oil, Sesamum Indicum (Sesame) Seed Extract, Tocopherol, CI 17200 (Red 33 Lake), CI 73360 (Red 30 Lake), CI 77491/CI 77499 (Iron Oxides), CI 15850 (Red 7 Lake), CI 15985 (Yellow 6 Lake).
